policy: Reviewed, time-limited exceptions to the OSV build-dependency gate (tools/check-build-deps.mjs). An exception records a deliberate decision that a specific OSV advisory does not apply to how Wingman uses the package at BUILD time, or that no fixed release exists yet. It is not a way to silence a finding that has not been assessed. Every entry must carry a justification and an expiry; the check fails once an exception expires - and also as soon as it is within 14 days of expiry, so a renewal is prepared ahead of the deadline instead of being discovered by a red build. Nothing here can quietly become permanent.

exceptions.justification: Assessed 2026-10-06: braces 3.0.3 is reachable only through the root development Tailwind/chokidar/micromatch toolchain. Tailwind content patterns are fixed repository paths in tailwind.config.js (index.html and src source files). Customer input does not supply glob patterns; no application or API source imports braces or micromatch, and the API server has a separate lockfile. The upstream advisory lists no patched release and npm latest remains 3.0.3. Retain this build-only exception until an upstream fix or a separately validated Tailwind migration; reassess before expiry. This does not accept runtime use of attacker-controlled patterns.
